text:
maya: Quick sync — two new open models landed in the catalog (ozark-lite and pebble-7b). Need cross-team check: licensing status, perf profile, and CR queue for the model runtimes. Can owners plz confirm?

samir: I can take ozark-lite ownership for perf + quant checks. License looks MIT-like but legal double-check needed. Will run perf pass tomorrow afternoon.

olivia: pebble-7b perf numbers: quick smoke on E2E latency looks fine at 512 tokens but KV-cache eviction shows a regression vs baseline. Repro steps: run loadgen with sequence=512, batch=8.

maya: thanks. @samir @olivia can we get a short checklist for canary gating? i.e. license ok, perf within 10% of baseline, memory under x, monitoring hooks?

jim: infra note — dedicated canary pool has capacity for 2x pebble-7b instances. Need CR to bump gpu request for the runtime (currently 8Gi). Pinged eng-infra CR queue.

liz: product gating: we need SLA doc updated and owners in the launch spreadsheet before we flip hosted visibility. Please add owners + support contact here: https://redwood.internal/sheets/model-launch (cc @maya)

samir: checklist draft: 1) legal signoff 2) perf within 10% baseline (p50 token latency) 3) mem < 28GB w/ kv cache 4) CI smoke + loadgen 5) observability events wired. I'll post perf sheet link when tests finish.

olivia: early perf numbers: p50 token latency ~8.9ms on rtx-pool for pebble-7b (batch 8). KV eviction test: p90 increases ~22% when sequence>1024. I'm adding a small adapter to avoid full cache churn.

maya: @legal-bot any quick confirm on pebble license? we saw a custom clause in the LICENSE file but not sure if it restricts commercial hosted usage.

legal-bot: pebble-7b LICENSE: custom-attenuator-clause; flagged for manual review. Assigned to @liz-legal. ETA 48h. Link: https://legal.redwood/pebble-7b/license-review/12345

maya: cool — that works. For CRs: @jim which queue should owners target for runtime changes?

jim: target eng-runtime/cr-review and cc eng-infra. If it's just container resource bump, tag as "infra-runtime-small". For adapter code olivia mentioned, tag eng-ml and eng-runtime.

olivia: putting a tiny PR up for the KV adapter now: draft PR -> #3092. Will mark ready for review after unit tests.

samir: will schedule perf run after olivia's adapter lands. Also will add a short toggled canary plan: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% over 48h with rollback on quality/regression alerts.

maya: last ask — can each owner drop a one-line final gate comment when they finish their item? we'll close out and schedule canary creation.

deploy-bot: Canary pool for pebble-7b pre-provision check: capacity ok, reserved 2 gpus. To create canary run `/deploy canary create pebble-7b --pool=canary-pool --scale=2`

liz: will coordinate with legal and product once license clears. tagging this thread in the launch spreadsheet row.

maya: excellent — thanks everyone. I'll collate and post the final gate checklist here once we have legal + olivia perf update. :thumbsup:
